# The Host Bali

> Direct-booking site for 14 private villas in Bali (Sanur, Ungasan, Umalas, Canggu) — all managed by our own team, not an aggregator. Guests book commission-free via WhatsApp (+62 857 4649 9697), or via Airbnb / Booking.com. Rates on request — same-day quote on WhatsApp.
